understanding.purpose: தமிழ்நாட்டுக் கோயில்களின் இடம், திறக்கும் நேரம் மற்றும் சிறப்புகளை ஒப்பிட்டுப் பார்க்க உதவும் அட்டவணை.
understanding.reading: வாசகர் கோயில் அல்லது நகரத்தை முதலில் கண்டறிந்து, அதே வரிசையில் நேரத்தையும் சிறப்பையும் படிப்பார்; பல கோயில்களின் நேரங்களையும் ஒப்பிடலாம். சிறப்புப் பகுதி நீளமான உரையாக இருப்பதால் வரிசைகள் உயரமாகலாம்.
groups: திறக்கும் நேரமும் சிறப்பும் ஒவ்வொரு கோயிலைப் பற்றிய பயனுள்ள விவரங்கள்; நேரத்தைப் பத்தியாகவும் சிறப்பை வரிசை வாரியாகவும் படிக்கலாம்.
may_wrap: திறக்கும் நேரத்தின் தனித்தனி வரம்புகளைப் பிரித்து மடிக்கலாம்.
சிறப்புப் பகுதியில் சொற்களுக்கு இடையில் இயல்பாக மடிக்கலாம்; அதனால் ஏற்படும் வரிசை உயரம் மற்ற செல்களின் மடிப்பையும் ஏற்கும்.

bad.why: The narrow specialties column produces up to eight lines per cell and very tall rows, leaving large areas of empty space in the other columns and making comparisons slow.

final.rationale: r3A keeps temple names, cities and both opening periods visible together in the initial viewport without splitting words. Its wider specialties column gives the seven data rows a consistent height and limits cells to four lines. Reading specialties requires substantial horizontal scrolling, but the width improves their readability and the rhythm of the whole table.

general: Allocate width according to content and reading role rather than making columns equal.
Keep identifiers and comparable values visible together where possible, and avoid breaking words.
Judge horizontal scrolling against the row height and reading burden caused by narrower columns.
specific: The first three columns fit almost exactly within the phone viewport at the preferred widths.
The long Tamil specialties drive row height, so extra width there materially improves the table's rhythm.

final.tradeoffs: r2A and r3B reduce horizontal scrolling at the cost of taller rows; r1C keeps the time header on one line but pushes part of the opening hours beyond the initial viewport.
final.uncertain: The width ranges are conservative: only the stated r3A widths were rendered with its four-line maximum. Nearby widths may be equally good, but line wrapping and viewport fit would need checking.

A.why: Temple names and cities are readable, and each opening-time range stays together. The specialties require horizontal scrolling, and their wrapping makes rows fairly tall.

B.why: All four columns fit in the viewport, but severe word and time-range splitting makes the table extremely tall and difficult to scan.

C.why: Temple names and cities are mostly readable, but each time range breaks across lines. Very little of the specialty column appears initially, while its wrapping makes the rows tall.

D.why: Cities and complete time ranges are easy to compare, but the specialty column begins at the viewport edge and requires scrolling. The first temple name takes three lines.

E.why: Temple names and cities read clearly, and the times remain on one line, but the viewport cuts through the times and leaves specialties entirely offscreen.

F.why: Temple names, cities, and complete time ranges are easy to scan together. The wider specialty column gives the rows a more compact rhythm, though it requires horizontal scrolling.

reviews.unsure: The supplied image previews show only a narrow portion of the offscreen specialty columns, so their full widths, word wrapping, and scrolling distances are difficult to judge.

A.why: Temple names and cities read clearly, but the viewport cuts through the opening times and leaves the specialities out of sight. The tall rows also leave much empty space in the visible columns.

B.why: Temple, city and complete opening-time ranges fit in the initial viewport, with names and times wrapping naturally. The specialities require horizontal scrolling.

C.why: All four columns fit, but the narrow cells split Tamil words and time ranges repeatedly. The speciality text becomes a very long, fragmented column, making rows difficult to follow.

D.why: Temple names and cities are readable, but each opening-time range breaks across lines and only a sliver of the speciality column appears initially. The long rows make comparisons harder.

E.why: Cities and complete time ranges fit in view, but the first temple name takes three lines and the speciality column begins at the viewport edge. Its tall rows slow scanning.

F.why: The first three columns fit in view, with readable temple names and complete time ranges. Specialities require scrolling, and the rows are somewhat taller than in B.

reviews.unsure: The supplied images show only a narrow part of the speciality column in the horizontally scrolling layouts, so its full width and text wrapping are difficult to compare directly.
